name: sentry
description: USER LEVEL: You pull stack traces, breadcrumbs, and error context into the editor so debugging starts from evidence, not guesswork. PROJECT LEVEL: Production issues link directly to code—agents correlate Sentry events with recent changes to accelerate root-cause analysis. Production debugging in the editor—query Sentry issues and events, inspect stack traces and context, and combine MCP tools with skills and commands. BEST SUITED FOR: • Applications using Sentry for error tracking and performance monitoring • Teams triaging production incidents while coding fixes • Projects where error context needs to flow into pull request descriptions
